messages:
maria: quick heads-up — profiler shows repeated queue stalls when a KV eviction coincides with a kernel swap. we saw short bursts of soft-429s around 15:02 UTC. root cause looks like head-of-line blocking: large microbatches waiting for a kernel hot-start while small requests behind them time out.
chris: can you paste the profiling snippet? what were token budgets and batch sizes at that moment?
lee: do we have KV miss rate + kernel_select latency correlated? that combo can absolutely create transient gridlock.
maria: pasted simplified metrics: `kernel_select_lat_ms=9.2`, `kv_eviction_rate=0.14`, `mean_batch_wait_ms=72`, `p95_latency_ms=312`, `soft429_rate=0.9%`. token_budget default=1024, many low-priority lanes still use default.
nisha: hmm. two quick levers: 1) avoid head-of-line by admitting a few small "gap" slots that let small/low-token requests pass, 2) allow immediate fallback to a smaller kernel when kernel_select latency exceeds threshold.
maria: proposing a lightweight 'gap allocator' that steals a tiny admission window (eg 8-16ms) to flush low-token reqs instead of blocking whole batch. also limit token_budget per low-priority lane to 256. config example I'm thinking: 
```
admission:
  gap_allocator: true
  gap_window_ms: 12
  token_budget:
    default: 1024
    low_priority_lane: 256
kv:
  prefetch:
    enabled: false
    hot_prefix_count: 1000
  eviction_backoff_ms: 200
```
chris: looks sane. test plan: canary with 1% traffic, measure `admit_gap_utilization`, `head_block_time_ms`, `kernel_fallback_count`. also compare p50/p95.
lee: add a guard: if `kernel_fallback_count` > 3/min revert gap_allocator and increase gap_window to avoid oscillation. and add a short probation so we don't flip every minute.
deploy-bot: canary deploy triggered: "gap-allocator-v1" -> us-west-2 (canary=1% traffic) at 1710729950.
maria: thanks, i'll attach a trace tag `gap-test` and run a 30m window. i'll also create a lightweight perf-regression alert: if p95 latency increases > 15% or soft-429_rate increases vs baseline, auto-rollback.
nisha: 👍 also consider adding a kernel-selection hint: if request token_estimate < 64, prefer low-startup kernel immediately (avoid selection delay). that should reduce need for broad gap windows.
maria: good call — we'll add `kernel_hint_small_req=true` to the canary. I'll post results here after 30m.
chris: if the canary looks good let's promote and then run a 6-hour soak with increased KV churn to validate eviction/backoff interactions.
lee: and log a follow-up task to profile prefix prefetch memory vs hit-rate; prefetch helps but memory tradeoffs are real.
maria: noted — creating follow-ups: PERF-INVEST-215 (canary results + rollout decision) and PERF-REG-216 (regression monitoring).
nisha: also file an oncall runbook snippet: how to disable gap-allocator quickly and where to find `head_block_time_ms` graph.
maria: will add runbook snippet in the ticket. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
